title: Welsh Beef Roast with Herby Horseradish Sauce
description: A classic Welsh-inspired beef roast served with a tangy herby horseradish sauce. Perfect for special occasions or a hearty Sunday dinner.

ingredients.name: herbs
ingredients.notes: fresh thyme and rosemary work well

instructions: Season the beef roast with salt and black pepper.
Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a large oven-safe pan over high heat.
Sear the beef roast for 2-3 minutes on each side, then transfer to the oven.
Roast for 20 minutes per kilogram, or until the beef reaches your desired level of doneness.
While the beef is roasting, mix the horseradish and herbs in a small bowl.
After the beef has been roasting for 30 minutes, baste it with butter and add the horseradish mixture to the pan.
Continue roasting for another 20-30 minutes, or until the beef is cooked through and the sauce is bubbly.
Let the beef rest for 10-15 minutes before slicing and serving.
Serve with additional herby horseradish sauce if desired.
